0.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON040ENHANCEMODE_00207_JALZAHN_000_000
0.description: By soulglazing your relic, I can render it aethertight, thus allowing the soul energy within to fully attune to its host.

1.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON040ENHANCEMODE_00207_MENU_TITLE
1.description: Select the relic you wish to have soulglazed.

7.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON040ENHANCEMODE_00207_JALZAHN_000_030
7.description: Where is the relic? Perchance you forgot to bring it?

8.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON040ENHANCEMODE_00207_SYSTEM_000_031
8.description: Please ensure that the relic you wish to have soulglazed is either equipped, in your Armoury Chest, or in your inventory before speaking with Jalzahn.

9.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON040ENHANCEMODE_00207_JALZAHN_000_040
9.description: Hm, it appears that this relic has already been soulglazed. The rest is up to you, my friend. With your weapon in hand, do that which you do best: adventure. In due course, the spirit energy it bears shall become fully attuned.

10.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON040ENHANCEMODE_00207_SYSTEM_000_041
10.description: Completing certain activities while equipped with your soulglazed relic weapon will increase its soul attunement level.

11.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON040ENHANCEMODE_00207_SYSTEM_000_042
11.description: By using the Zodiac glass, it is possible to visually verify attunement progress.

12.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON040ENHANCEMODE_00207_SYSTEM_000_043
12.description: Once your relic weapon novus has achieved full soul attunement, you may present it to Jalzahn to have it upgraded to a relic weapon nexus.

13.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON040ENHANCEMODE_00207_JALZAHN_000_100
13.description: Without further ado, I shall apply soulglaze to your weapon. Not a spot shall be left uncoated.

14.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON040ENHANCEMODE_00207_JALZAHN_000_101
14.description: ...Yes, that should do it. The relic is now completely aethertight.

15.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON040ENHANCEMODE_00207_JALZAHN_000_102
15.description: With your weapon in hand, do that which you do best: adventure. In due course, the spirit energy it bears shall become fully attuned.

16.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON040ENHANCEMODE_00207_SYSTEM_000_110
16.description: Completing certain activities while equipped with your soulglazed relic weapon will increase its soul attunement level.

17.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON040ENHANCEMODE_00207_SYSTEM_000_111
17.description: By using the Zodiac glass, it is possible to visually verify attunement progress.

18.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON040ENHANCEMODE_00207_SYSTEM_000_112
18.description: Once your relic weapon novus has achieved full soul attunement, you may present it to Jalzahn to have it enhanced to a relic weapon nexus.

19.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON040ENHANCEMODE_00207_SYSTEM_000_113
19.description: The upgraded weapon will retain the power it received from materia by way of the sphere scroll.

20.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON040ENHANCEMODE_00207_SYSTEM_000_114
20.description: It is possible to alter the materia-enhanced properties of your relic, both before and after the aforementioned upgrade. To initiate the process, please speak with Jalzahn.
